g.text: FINFLOW: SMART DOCUMENT & ACCOUNTING AUTOMATION — ARCHITECTURE MAP (n8n v2.48.5 · 50 NODES · STATUS: ACTIVE)
* Ingests Incoming Requests: Listens on POST /webhook/finflow for document uploads (multipart/form-data) and dashboard polling events.
* MIME-Type & Format Detection: Inspects file headers and binary extensions (.pdf, .csv, .xlsx, .txt, .jpg, .png).
* Conditional Branching: An 8-way Switch routes execution to the appropriate native parser or dashboard query pipeline.
3. Route Action or Document (Execution branch router)
* Unpacks Raw Data: Extracts textual and tabular data from binary files without loss.
* Multi-Format Parsers: Dedicated nodes for PDF text streams, CSV row parsing, Excel worksheets, and plain text files.
* Schema Normalization: Combines parsed rows into a standardized text representation for the AI extraction stage.
1. Extract PDF Content (Extracts text layers from invoice PDFs)
2. Extract CSV Content (Parses comma-separated statement rows)
3. Extract Excel Content (Reads XLSX spreadsheet sheets)
4. Extract Text File Content (Ingests plain text accounting logs)
5. Unify Extracted Content (Aggregates and formats for LLM)
* Zero-Hallucination Information Extraction: Google Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite analyzes invoice text to identify key financial fields.
* Strict JSON Schema: Extracts Vendor Name, Invoice #, Invoice Date, Due Date, Expense Category, Currency, Subtotal, Tax, and Total.
* Resilient Fallback: If LLM output fails validation or API errors occur, a regex/heuristic fallback parser ensures pipeline continuity.
1. Gemini Financial Extractor (Google Gemini LLM node)
2. Parse & Validate Gemini Output (Validates JSON schema)
3. AI Fallback & Error Handler (Regex/OCR heuristic safety net)
* Strict Arithmetic Validation: Enforces Subtotal + Tax = Total using deterministic JavaScript math (avoids LLM calculation errors).
* Currency Isolation: Preserves ISO currency codes (USD, EUR, GBP, INR). Prevents mixing different currencies without verified FX rates.
* Debit/Credit Segregation: Strictly separates expense invoices from revenue streams.
1. Normalize & Validate Financial Record (Deterministic verification & sanitization)
* Historical Fingerprint Lookup: Queries existing transactions in SQLite by invoice_number and vendor_name.
* Vendor Directory Check: Checks if the vendor already exists or needs to be registered.
* Integrity Routing: Routes valid records to storage, duplicates to rejection, and incomplete scans to the review queue.
🏦 STAGE 6: PERSISTENT STORAGE & CRM SYNC (SUCCESS PATH)
* Vendor Upsert: Registers new vendor or updates existing vendor spend statistics in SQLite.
* Ledger Commitment: Inserts the validated transaction into finflow_crm_transactions.
* Audit Trail: Appends timestamped log entry to finflow_activity.
* Telemetry Refresh: Reloads all data tables and returns updated real-time CRM state with HTTP 200 OK.
1. Save Vendor Record -> Store Validated Transaction -> Log Success Activity
3. Format Processed CRM Response -> Respond Document Processed (HTTP 200)
* Audit Logging: Logs duplicate submission attempt with timestamp and offending invoice ID.
* Client Alert: Returns HTTP 409 Conflict to prevent double-payment or double-counting in accounting.
* Incomplete Document Handling: If key fields (e.g. Total, Invoice #) are missing or OCR confidence is low.
* Review Isolation: Writes to finflow_review_queue instead of main ledger to preserve accounting integrity.
* Client Status: Returns HTTP 202 Accepted indicating manual verification required.
📊 STAGE 7: LIVE CRM DASHBOARD TELEMETRY PIPELINE
* Dedicated Data Aggregator: Triggered when the web app requests dashboard state (action=dashboard_snapshot).
* Sequential SQLite Querying: Fetches all transactions, vendors, review items, and activity logs.
* Deterministic Metrics Engine: Computes Income, Expenses, Net Profit, and Category distribution strictly per currency.
* Response: Returns compiled JSON dashboard payload with HTTP 200 OK.
* Exception Trapping: Catches corrupted files, password-protected PDFs, or invalid binary payloads.
* Safety Net: Writes failure details to review queue and activity log.
* Client Alert: Responds with HTTP 400/422 with actionable error diagnostics.
